candidates.rationale: A fresh drop in the accrual gap means earnings are increasingly cash-backed rather than accrual-driven; the market underreacts to this earnings-quality improvement in the days right after the print (Sloan accrual anomaly).

Ranks how recently operating margin last jumped, i.e. days since the last quarterly print; attention and drift are strongest right after a report and fade as the quarter ages, and since firms report on staggered days this recency measure keeps rotating across the cross-section.

Tilts the accrual-quality-improvement signal toward low-liquidity, low-coverage names, where limited investor attention means fundamental news diffuses more slowly and the mispricing persists longer before correction.

A sharp 5-day price drop is more likely a liquidity-driven overreaction that mean-reverts when the firm's underlying ROA is solid, versus a justified repricing when profitability is weak, so gating short-term reversal on quality should sharpen the reversal signal.

Firms whose operating margin expanded while leverage fell over the trailing two quarters are funding improvement internally rather than through financial engineering, an intermediate-horizon operating-improvement signal the market prices in gradually.

Low realized quarter-to-quarter ROE volatility over the trailing two years proxies earnings stability; investors underprice this safety premium, so firms with steadier profitability should earn a return premium over erratic ones (QMJ-style safety channel).

Combines earnings yield priced off the same-day raw open (avoiding the dividend-adjusted-close lookahead) with current profitability, so cheapness is rewarded only when it is not a profitability-driven value trap.

Ranks recency of the last material change in capital structure; risk-sensitive investors re-rate a recently altered balance sheet only gradually, so how fresh the leverage shift is carries information that decays slowly over the following year.

A full year of steadily positive returns combined with high capital efficiency (revenue per asset dollar) flags durable operational strength that the market has only partly recognized, with the two slow-moving signals reinforcing each other.

Operating margin times asset turnover reconstructs DuPont operating ROA independent of financing choices; subtracting a separate leverage rank isolates firms generating returns through operating efficiency rather than balance-sheet risk-taking.

prompt:
You are proposing quantitative factor expressions for US large-cap equities.

Universe and data
- S&P 500 point-in-time constituents, roughly 500 names per day.
- Daily bars only, plus point-in-time quarterly fundamentals stamped from the
  report date. Every field is referenced with a leading `$`:
    $open $high $low $close $adj_close $volume $dollar_volume $return
    $roa $roe $operating_margin $leverage $asset_turnover
    $book_per_share $earnings_per_share $accrual_gap
  A bare name such as `close` is not a field and will be rejected.
- Execution convention: the signal is computed after the close of day T and the
  position is entered at the open of T+1.
- The window these factors are fitted and judged on runs from 2000 to 2013.
  Do not reason about anything later; you will never be shown a number from
  outside that window.

Syntax
- Operators are function calls: TS_MEAN, TS_STD, TS_MAX, TS_MIN, TS_RANK,
  TS_DELTA, TS_CORR, TS_COV, TS_SUM, TS_PRODUCT, TS_ARGMAX, TS_ARGMIN,
  TS_DECAY_LINEAR, EMA, DELAY, DELTA, RANK, ZSCORE, CS_RANK, CS_ZSCORE,
  CS_DEMEAN, IF, IF_ELSE, MIN, MAX, ABS, SIGN, LOG, LN, SQRT, POWER, BOUND,
  COUNT.
- Lookback windows must be positive integer literals, e.g. TS_MEAN($close, 21).
- Guard every division with a small epsilon: `/ (TS_STD($close, 21) + 1e-8)`.
- Well-formed example: -RANK(TS_CORR(RANK($close), RANK($volume), 5))

Hard limits every proposal must satisfy, or it is rejected before it is scored
- at most 200 characters
- at most 5 distinct `$fields`
- at most 4 free numeric constants (lookback windows and
  the 1e-8 epsilon guard do not count)
- expression tree depth at most 6
- must not share a complete sub-expression of 4 or more
  nodes with any published Alpha101 formula, or with any factor already in the
  archive. Restating a published alpha is the one thing that is always rejected.
- must cover at least 90% of the panel
- absolute rank correlation below 0.80 against every archive member

Output
- Return valid JSON only, matching the supplied JSON schema. No prose outside it.
